name: Chudesa chudesnye
source:
Only sincere love will be for the good. If love turns out to be a sneaky deception, the result will be terrible for the one who loves and the consequences will be unpredictable.

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/3-1-0-573]Anivisual[/url]]
translation:
只有真诚的爱才会带来美好。如果爱情最终是一场偷偷摸摸的欺骗，那么对于所爱的人来说，结果将是可怕的，后果将是难以预料的。

[译自[url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/3-1-0-573]Anivis[/url]]
